scope.description: Library-to-caller message publication dependency for positive remote MsgAppResp under the asynchronous storage interface, with a legal accepted append followed by a duplicate before local storage completion.
assumptions: Message duplication is exact and originates from an actual leader-produced MsgApp in the same execution.
The caller processes local append messages reliably and in order and releases attached responses only after completion.
No crash, membership change or malformed network message is needed.
excluded: Disk crash persistence, global agreement after restart and client-visible application results.
Liveness under indefinite local storage delay.
